name: Re:Rem Plus
source: Emilia, Roswaal, and Ram all left the Roswaal's Mansion, and now only you and Rem are left to look after it. What will happen when two lovers are given so much time to spend alone together? An alternative story where Subaru (You) chose Rem. Events take place approximately in-between 2nd and 3rd arcs of Re:Zero.
